data.one_liner: Google Gemini SDK for Flutter and Dart to integrate Gemini AI models.
data.what_it_does: Provides a bridge between a Flutter or Dart application and Google's Gemini AI. It allows generating text from text-only inputs or text-and-image inputs, with support for generation configuration and safety settings.
use_when: You want to integrate Google Gemini AI into your Flutter or Dart app.
You need to perform natural language processing tasks like text completion or summarization.
You need to process text and image inputs using Gemini models.
avoid_when: You need built-in multi-turn chat support immediately, as it is marked as in progress in the README.
You require response streaming, which is currently in progress.
strengths: Easy initialization with an API key.
Supports model configuration parameters like temperature and max output tokens.
Supports safety settings and threshold adjustments.
weaknesses: Some features like multi-turn conversations and streaming are marked as in progress.
Relies on a third-party API key and external service availability.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a Gemini API key from ai.google.dev.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Firebase client for Google generative AI models.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: For running local LLMs instead of relying on a cloud-hosted Gemini API.

data.minimal_example:
final gemini = GoogleGemini(apiKey: "--- Your Gemini Api Key --- ");
gemini.generateFromText("Tell me a story").then((value) => print(value.text)).catchError((e) => print(e));
